caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden clock with a polished brown finish and a visible wood grain pattern. The clock case consists of two main sections: the upper section houses a circular clock face with black Arabic numerals and two black hands, while the lower section features a rectangular panel bordered in a lighter brown or gold color with an oval-shaped yellowish or golden accent in the center. The upper section of the case is adorned with a decorative element at the top center. The clock face includes a white background with a lower segment decorated with gold ornamental designs and the word "SALOON" inscribed. The entire clock stands on four short, carved feet. The drawing is executed on an off-white background and includes a signature at the lower left corner.
title: Shelf Clock
